model.name: diagram.edgeAutoscroll
model.description: R33.6.2 (architect design cd5bc0de9): DIAGRAM edge-autoscroll during element drag. In wireBoxDrag pointermove, when the drag pointer is within/past a 24px surface edge-band, a requestAnimationFrame loop calls the NEW RbPanZoom.panBy(dx,dy) (speed proportional to overshoot, capped) so ONLY the diagram pans toward the edge; the box keeps tracking the pointer in content-space. Stops on pointerup/cancel. INV-D2. Page-scroll suppression (INV-D1) is by-construction CSS (.dm-box touch-action:none + existing setPointerCapture) - no method. Singular chain = the NEW decl panBy; the wireBoxDrag edge-rAF is a call-site (mirrors R33.5 setEnabled pattern). Reuse RbPanZoom clamp+apply, NO fork.
